referee_caveats_inferred: 3DBarolo fits use very different inclinations for CO (75 deg) and H2 (33-37 deg), so the kinematic comparison depends on the disc geometry and FOV
Two-temperature fits to five lines per region have few degrees of freedom and no stated fitting algorithm or error treatment
Outflow mass, rate and energy for R5 are upper limits from one low-mass knot, with a rough velocity and radius
ALMA beam (0.65'') is coarser than MIRI Ch1-Ch2 resolution, so beam smearing and resolution differences affect the CO vs H2 comparison
The statement that the jet does not affect the gas rests on a visual comparison with a 1999 VLA map

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: ALMA: two execution blocks, band 6, 1.875 GHz bandwidth, likely tens of GB raw; JWST MIRI MRS: 12 sub-band cubes, several GB
reproducibility.score_reason: The ALMA program is named and the CO imaging recipe (CASA 5.6.1-8, robust 2, 15 km/s, uvcontsub) is largely given, but tclean geometry, 3DBarolo setup and the MIRI cube processing details are missing, and the rotational-diagram fitting is not specified.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Key steps (MIRI cube reduction with custom masking, ALUCINE fits, 3DBarolo ring setup and rotational-diagram fitting) are not specified enough to redo from the paper alone, and the JWST data are required.
